description: This file defines the internal sealed class ActivationRebalancerMonitor, which implements monitoring and lifecycle management for the activation rebalancer component within the Orleans runtime. It manages periodic reporting, rebalancing commands, and listener notifications, playing a critical role in activation load balancing and health monitoring.

classes.name: ActivationRebalancerMonitor
classes.description: A runtime monitor class responsible for overseeing the activation rebalancer, handling periodic reports, lifecycle events, and listener notifications within the Orleans silo infrastructure.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the monitor to lifecycle events for startup and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Initializes and starts the monitor timer to periodically check and retrieve rebalancing reports.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup and migration if needed when the monitor stops.

methods.name: ResumeRebalancing
methods.description: Instructs the rebalancer to resume operations.

methods.name: SuspendRebalancing
methods.description: Instructs the rebalancer to suspend operations for a specified duration.

methods.name: GetRebalancingReport
methods.description: Retrieves the latest rebalancing report, optionally forcing a new fetch.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Updates the monitor with a new report and notifies listeners.

methods.name: SubscribeToReports
methods.description: Adds a listener to receive report updates.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromReports
methods.description: Removes a listener from report notifications.
